openings.claim: Inherited 90-minute allocations may mismatch usable durations, windows and equipment.
openings.discriminator: Accepted rearrangements improve needs coverage; persistent peak/piano scarcity limits benefit.
openings.probe: Ask contacts for total needs, minimum useful durations, windows and equipment; compare current and feasible proposed schedules, counting only accepted alternatives.
openings.uncertainty: Contacts may misrepresent needs; 68% reserved and missed sessions do not establish usable spare capacity.

openings.claim: An authoritative desk calendar, dated changes and room/date/time read-back may reduce conflicting expectations.
openings.discriminator: Calendar-divergence conflicts decline; other causes may persist.
openings.fit: Preserves telephone/in-person access without accounts or purchases.
openings.probe: Trace online copies to confirmed changes; track conflict causes and weekly administration for eight weeks.
openings.uncertainty: Desk coordination is unproven; recording may increase workload.

openings.claim: Window/equipment-aware exchanges plus committed revisions checked at key collection may jointly improve access and reliability.
openings.discriminator: Combined operation outperforms confirmation alone on needs and matching alone on contradictory authorizations.
openings.fit: Obtain all affected groups' consent before committing an entire exchange; existing reservations remain valid until then.
openings.probe: Replay identical requests under current practice, matching, revisions, and both; simulate a change between copying and key collection. Count fully met needs, contradictory authorizations and minutes. Trial consented exchanges with revision-marked copies.
openings.uncertainty: Alternatives and consent may be absent; no feasible exchange rejects the allocation-benefit hypothesis.

decision: Probe feasibility first. Preserve two rooms, 24 staffed hours, requested weekly 60-minute entitlements, existing equipment, no new fees, both performances and offline booking/change channels. Entitlements may fall short of actual needs. Eight-week acceptance: at least 90% stated needs within accepted windows, fewer than two conflicts, administration at most two hours/week. Synthetic observations establish neither feasibility nor target attainment.
